text: no it was a head face deleted. the plane created a face or it did a cut it did something clearly very wrong idk what it is but it seems to have made a random ass cut in one other outliner, and then removing it, removed half of the cut it introduced while retaining the other half  right like if u look this is what it did [Image #1] the red lines are all the things it introduced while the green line is what it was previously
resolution: The marked extra red topology was traced to invalid cross-outliner edit ownership rather than a harmless overlay. Structural append and delete now fail closed before mutation whenever host ownership and outliner metadata diverge, preventing the add-transform-delete sequence from splitting and partially removing a head face.
